characteristics.description: Institutional names, addresses, location and classification for each year, 1984-2025. Some codes and fields have shorter histories.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.name: Name of institution location.
variables.webaddress: Admissions website URL of institution location.
variables.control_code: Raw NCES CONTROL code. In 1984-85 2 means private without profit distinction; from 1986, 1 public, 2 private nonprofit, 3 private for-profit. Special codes are retained.
variables.control: Readable control category; the 1984-85 private category is not split by profit status.
variables.level_code: Raw NCES ICLEVEL code: 1 four-year or above, 2 two-year, 3 less-than-two-year; early 7 means unclassified, not less-than-two-year.
variables.level: Readable institutional program level for recognized ICLEVEL codes.
variables.sector_code: Raw NCES SECTOR code, available from 1986; combines institutional control and program level. Special codes are retained.
variables.sector: Readable sector for codes 0-9; unrecognized/not-applicable codes stay missing.
variables.hbcu_code: Raw NCES HBCU code from 1992, including historical blanks and missing/nonresponse codes.
variables.hbcu: Historically Black college or university: nullable boolean; historical nonresponse is not interpreted as no.
variables.tribal_code: Raw NCES TRIBAL code from 1993, including historical blanks and missing/nonresponse codes.
variables.tribal: Tribal college or university: nullable boolean; historical nonresponse is not interpreted as no.
variables.degree_granting_code: Raw NCES DEGGRANT code from 2000; 1 degree-granting, 2 non-degree-granting.
variables.degree_granting: Nullable degree-granting indicator, derived from DEGGRANT codes 1 and 2.
variables.locale_code: Raw NCES LOCALE degree-of-urbanization code from 1995; its code system changes in 2005.
variables.locale_scheme: legacy for 1995-2004 LOCALE codes; urban_centric from 2005; missing before 1995.
variables.carnegie_2021_basic_code: 2021 Carnegie Basic Classification code (C21BASIC), available from 2021; not interchangeable with earlier Carnegie classification vintages.

admissions.description: Fall first-time degree/certificate-seeking admissions: applicants, admits, enrollees, test submissions and score percentiles, and year-specific admissions consideration codes; available for 2001-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.tot_applied: Total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking applicants in a given year.
variables.tot_admitted: Total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking applicants who were admitted in a given year.
variables.tot_enrolled: Total number of admitteees who ultimately enrolled (includes part-time and full-time enrollemnt).
variables.men_applied: Number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking men who applied to an institution in a given year.
variables.men_admitted: Number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking men who were admitted to an institution in a given year.
variables.men_enrolled: Number of admitted men who ultimately enrolled (includes part-time and full-time enrollemnt).
variables.women_applied: Number of first-time degree/certificate-seeking women applicants (APPLCNW).
variables.women_enrolled: Number of admitted women enrolling (ENRLW; derived from FT+PT counts in 2001).
variables.tot_ft_enrolled: Reported total full-time enrollees (ENRLFT), or men+women if absent in 2001.
variables.tot_pt_enrolled: Reported total part-time enrollees (ENRLPT), or men+women if absent in 2001.
variables.another_gender_applied: Applicants of another gender (APPLCNAN), available from 2022; supplemental reporting may overlap binary totals.
variables.gender_unknown_applied: Applicants with gender unknown (APPLCNUN), available from 2022.
variables.another_gender_admitted: Admits of another gender (ADMSSNAN), available from 2022.
variables.gender_unknown_admitted: Admits with gender unknown (ADMSSNUN), available from 2022.
variables.another_gender_enrolled: Enrollees of another gender (ENRLAN), available from 2022.
variables.gender_unknown_enrolled: Enrollees with gender unknown (ENRLUN), available from 2022.
variables.another_gender_ft_enrolled: Full-time enrollees of another gender (ENRLFTAN), available from 2022.
variables.gender_unknown_ft_enrolled: Full-time enrollees with gender unknown (ENRLFTUN), available from 2022.
variables.another_gender_pt_enrolled: Part-time enrollees of another gender (ENRLPTAN), available from 2022.
variables.gender_unknown_pt_enrolled: Part-time enrollees with gender unknown (ENRLPTUN), available from 2022.
variables.accept_rate_total: Total admitted / total applicants times 100, using the published totals when available; zero denominator is missing.
variables.yield_rate_men: Yield rate (share of admitted students who ultimately enrolled) of male admittees.
variables.yield_rate_women: Yield rate (share of admitted students who ultimately enrolled) of female admittees.
variables.yield_rate_total: Total enrolled / total admitted times 100, using published totals when available; zero denominator is missing.
variables.men_applied_share: Male share of total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking applicants in a given year.
variables.men_admitted_share: Male share of total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking admittees in a given year.
variables.share_submit_sat: Percentage of first-time degree/certificate-seeking students submitting SAT scores (SATPCT), not a percentage of all admitted applicants.
variables.share_submit_act: Percentage of first-time degree/certificate-seeking students submitting ACT scores (ACTPCT), not a percentage of all admitted applicants.
variables.num_submit_sat: Number of first-time degree/certificate-seeking students submitting SAT scores (SATNUM).
variables.num_submit_act: Number of first-time degree/certificate-seeking students submitting ACT scores (ACTNUM).
variables.sat_math_50: SAT mathematics score (50th percentile), available from 2022.
variables.consider_gpa_code: Raw ADMCON1 code for considering high school GPA; code meaning changes in 2022.
variables.consider_class_rank_code: Raw ADMCON2 code for considering high school rank.
variables.consider_school_record_code: Raw ADMCON3 code for considering high school record.
variables.consider_college_prep_code: Raw ADMCON4 code for considering college-preparatory coursework.
variables.consider_recommendations_code: Raw ADMCON5 code for considering recommendations.
variables.consider_competencies_code: Raw ADMCON6 code for considering demonstrations of competencies.
variables.consider_test_scores_code: Raw ADMCON7 code for considering admissions test scores; 2022+ code 5 means test optional and 3 test blind.
variables.consider_english_proficiency_code: Raw ADMCON8 code for considering an English proficiency test.
variables.consider_other_tests_code: Raw ADMCON9 code for considering another test; available from 2005.
variables.consider_work_experience_code: Raw ADMCON10 code for considering work experience; available from 2022.
variables.consider_essay_code: Raw ADMCON11 code for considering a personal statement/essay; available from 2022.
variables.consider_legacy_code: Raw ADMCON12 code for considering legacy status; available from 2022.
variables.consider_gpa: Year-specific readable label for consider_gpa_code; NCES codes are not a constant ordinal importance scale.
variables.consider_test_scores: Year-specific readable label for consider_test_scores_code; distinguishes 2022+ test optional/blind.
variables.consider_other_tests: Year-specific readable label for consider_other_tests_code; available from 2005.
variables.consider_work_experience: Year-specific readable label for consider_work_experience_code; available from 2022.
variables.consider_essay: Year-specific readable label for consider_essay_code; available from 2022.
variables.consider_legacy: Year-specific readable label for consider_legacy_code; available from 2022.

enrollment.description: Enrollment data for each school in a given year (measured in the Fall), including information like the male enrollment share and enrollment by gender and race; available at the undergraduate or graduate level; available for years 1984-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.studentlevel: Level of student enrollment; either 'undergrad' (Undergraduate) or 'grad' (Graduate).
variables.totmen: Total number of men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totwomen: Total number of women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.wtmen: Total number of non-Hispanic White men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.wtwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic White women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.bkmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.bkwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.hspmen: Total number of Hispanic men (of any race) enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.hspwomen: Total number of Hispanic women (of any race) enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.asnmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.asnwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women enrolled in the Fall; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totmen_share: Male share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totwt_share: Non-Hispanic White share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totbk_share: Non-Hispanic Black share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.tothsp_share: Hispanic share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.
variables.totasn_share: Non-Hispanic Asian share of total enrollment; 'total' here is defined as the sum of male and female enrollment; this includes both part-time and full-time enrollment.

distance_enrollment.description: Fall students taking exclusively distance education courses, some distance education courses, or none, plus location of exclusively distance students; EF*_A_DIST files for fall 2012-2024.

variables.year: Fall enrollment reporting year; students enrolled for credit at the official fall date or October 15.
variables.student_level: EFDELEV category: total, undergrad, grad, degree_seeking UG, or non_degree UG; 'all' includes overlapping levels and total.
variables.source_level_code: Original EFDELEV code; 1 all students, 2 UG, 3 UG degree/certificate-seeking, 11 UG non-degree, 12 graduate.
variables.total_students: All students enrolled for credit in this source level (EFDETOT).
variables.exclusive_distance: Students taking exclusively distance education courses (EFDEEXC).
variables.some_distance: Students taking at least one but not exclusively distance education courses (EFDESOM).
variables.no_distance: Students taking no distance education courses (EFDENON).
variables.exclusive_same_state: Exclusively distance students located in institution's state/jurisdiction (EFDEEX1).
variables.exclusive_other_us_state: Exclusively distance students located in another known U.S. state/jurisdiction (EFDEEX2).
variables.exclusive_us_state_unknown: Exclusively distance students located in the U.S. but state/jurisdiction unknown (EFDEEX3).
variables.exclusive_outside_us: Exclusively distance students located outside the U.S. (EFDEEX4).
variables.exclusive_location_unknown: Exclusively distance students with location unknown/not reported (EFDEEX5).
variables.exclusive_share: exclusive_distance / total_students times 100; zero/missing denominator produces missing.
variables.some_share: some_distance / total_students times 100; zero/missing denominator produces missing.
variables.no_distance_share: no_distance / total_students times 100; zero/missing denominator produces missing.
variables.total_students_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for total_students (XEFDETOT).
variables.exclusive_distance_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for exclusive_distance (XEFDEEXC).
variables.some_distance_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for some_distance (XEFDESOM).
variables.no_distance_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for no_distance (XEFDENON).
variables.exclusive_same_state_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for exclusive_same_state (XEFDEEX1).
variables.exclusive_other_us_state_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for exclusive_other_us_state (XEFDEEX2).
variables.exclusive_us_state_unknown_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for exclusive_us_state_unknown (XEFDEEX3).
variables.exclusive_outside_us_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for exclusive_outside_us (XEFDEEX4).
variables.exclusive_location_unknown_status: NCES source reporting/imputation code for exclusive_location_unknown (XEFDEEX5).

twelve_month_enrollment.description: Unduplicated student headcounts for July 1 through June 30 by undergraduate, graduate, and (through 2010) first-professional level; EFFY files for reporting periods ending 2002-2025. This is not the Fall Enrollment snapshot.

variables.year: Ending year of the 12-month July-June reporting period; EFFY2025 covers July 2024-June 2025.
variables.period_start_year: Starting year of the July-June reporting period (year minus one).
variables.student_level: One of undergrad, grad, total, or first_professional (2002-2010). The total level overlaps the separate level rows.
variables.source_level_code: Original LSTUDY level code through 2019 or EFFYALEV code from 2020; consult level_code_system.
variables.level_code_system: lstudy through 2019 and effyalev from 2020. The expanded system also contains nested UG rows, which are not summed here.
variables.total_students: Unduplicated student headcount at the selected level (FYRACE24 through 2007, EFYTOTLT from 2008).
variables.men: Unduplicated headcount reported in the men's/male category (FYRACE15 through 2007, EFYTOTLM from 2008).
variables.women: Unduplicated headcount reported in the women's/female category (FYRACE16 through 2007, EFYTOTLW from 2008).
variables.nonresident: Nonresident students (FYRACE17 through 2007, EFYNRALT from 2008); category wording changes to U.S. Nonresident in 2025.
variables.black: Black, non-Hispanic headcount (FYRACE18 through 2007, EFYBKAAT from 2008); consult each year's race definitions.
variables.american_indian: American Indian/Alaska Native headcount (FYRACE19 through 2007, EFYAIANT from 2008).
variables.asian_pacific: Combined Asian/Pacific Islander headcount (FYRACE20), 2002-2007 only. Not additive with later separately reported Asian and Pacific Islander categories.
variables.white: White, non-Hispanic headcount (FYRACE22 through 2007, EFYWHITT from 2008).
variables.race_unknown: Race/ethnicity unknown headcount (FYRACE23 through 2007, EFYUNKNT from 2008).
variables.asian: Asian headcount (EFYASIAT), reported separately from Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander beginning 2008.
variables.pacific_islander: Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander headcount (EFYNHPIT), available from 2008.
variables.two_or_more: Two or more races headcount (EFY2MORT), available from 2008.
variables.asian_pacific_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for asian_pacific; missing when the field does not exist.
variables.asian_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for asian; missing before the field exists.
variables.pacific_islander_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pacific_islander; missing before the field exists.
variables.two_or_more_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for two_or_more; missing before the field exists.

tuition.description: Published undergraduate tuition and required fees, 2000-2024. Academic-year and program-year reporters are separate; 2024 moves from Institutional Characteristics to Cost I.

variables.year: Starting year of the published academic or program price period (e.g. 2024 means 2024-25).
variables.reporter: Academic-year or program-year price reporter; values academic or program.
variables.largest_program_cip: CIP code of largest program at program-year reporters; not a standardized price for every program.
variables.in_district_tuition: Average in-district tuition for full-time undergraduates at academic-year reporters; dollars, excluding required fees (TUITION1).
variables.in_district_fees: Required in-district fees for full-time undergraduates; dollars (FEE1).
variables.in_district_published_tuition_fees: Published in-district tuition plus required fees for full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CHG1AY3).
variables.in_state_tuition: Average in-state tuition for full-time undergraduates at academic-year reporters; dollars, excluding required fees (TUITION2).
variables.in_state_fees: Required in-state fees for full-time undergraduates; dollars (FEE2).
variables.in_state_published_tuition_fees: Published in-state tuition plus required fees for full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CHG2AY3).
variables.out_of_state_tuition: Average out-of-state tuition for full-time undergraduates at academic-year reporters; dollars, excluding required fees (TUITION3).
variables.out_of_state_fees: Required out-of-state fees for full-time undergraduates; dollars (FEE3).
variables.out_of_state_published_tuition_fees: Published out-of-state tuition plus required fees for full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CHG3AY3).
variables.program_published_tuition_fees: Published tuition plus required fees for the largest program for entering students at program-year reporters; dollars (CHG1PY3).
variables.largest_program_tuition_fees_no_ftft: Largest-program tuition plus required fees for institutions without full-time first-time undergraduates; dollars (CIPTUIT1), available from 2006.

student_aid.description: IPEDS Student Financial Aid grants and loans, for aid years ending 2002-2024. Early academic/program reporting cohorts and the all-undergraduate measures have different availability and denominators.

variables.year: Ending year of the aid period; e.g. SFA2324 describes aid year 2023-24, so year is 2024.
variables.aid_year_start: Starting year of the aid period (year minus one).
variables.reporter: Academic-year (fall cohort) or program-year (full-year cohort) aid reporting; academic or program.
variables.ftft_students: Full-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate financial-aid cohort; SCUGFFN from aid year 2007-08, otherwise SCFA1N (academic) or SCFY1N (program).
variables.ftft_students_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for the corresponding ftft_students source field.
variables.ug_students: Total undergraduate financial-aid cohort; SCUGRAD from aid year 2007-08, otherwise SCFA2 (academic) or SCFY2 (program).
variables.ug_students_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for the corresponding ug_students source field.
variables.ftft_net_price: Average net price for in-state/in-district FTFT undergraduates receiving federal, state/local, or institutional grants; dollars, available for aid years 2008-09 through 2023-24 (NPIST2; 2023-24 from Cost II).
variables.ftft_any_aid_count: FTFT students receiving/awarded any financial aid (ANYAIDN).
variables.ftft_any_aid_pct: NCES-published percentage of FTFT students receiving/awarded any financial aid (ANYAIDP).
variables.ftft_federal_grant_avg: Average federal grant dollars among FTFT federal-grant recipients (FGRNT_A).
variables.ftft_federal_grant_total: Total federal grant dollars to FTFT recipients (FGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_state_local_grant_avg: Average state/local grant dollars among FTFT recipients (SGRNT_A).
variables.ftft_state_local_grant_total: Total state/local grant dollars to FTFT recipients (SGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_institutional_grant_avg: Average institutional grant dollars among FTFT recipients (IGRNT_A).
variables.ftft_institutional_grant_total: Total institutional grant dollars to FTFT recipients (IGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_student_loan_count: FTFT recipients of student loans (LOAN_N), which may include nonfederal loans.
variables.ftft_student_loan_avg: Average student-loan dollars among FTFT loan recipients (LOAN_A).
variables.ftft_student_loan_total: Total student-loan dollars to FTFT recipients (LOAN_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_grant_count: FTFT recipients of federal, state/local or institutional grants (AGRNT_N); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_grant_avg: Average grant dollars among FTFT grant recipients (AGRNT_A); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_grant_total: Total grant dollars to FTFT recipients (AGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_pell_count: FTFT Pell Grant recipients (PGRNT_N); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_pell_avg: Average Pell Grant dollars among FTFT Pell recipients (PGRNT_A); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_pell_total: Total Pell Grant dollars to FTFT recipients (PGRNT_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ftft_federal_loan_count: FTFT recipients of federal student loans (FLOAN_N); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_federal_loan_avg: Average federal loan dollars among FTFT federal-loan recipients (FLOAN_A); available from aid year 2007-08.
variables.ftft_federal_loan_total: Total federal loan dollars to FTFT recipients (FLOAN_T); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_grant_count: All-undergraduate recipients of grants from federal, state/local, institutional or other sources (UAGRNTN); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_grant_avg: Average grant dollars among undergraduate grant recipients (UAGRNTA); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_grant_total: Total grant dollars to undergraduate grant recipients (UAGRNTT); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_pell_count: All-undergraduate Pell recipients (UPGRNTN); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_pell_avg: Average Pell Grant dollars among undergraduate Pell recipients (UPGRNTA); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_pell_total: Total Pell Grant dollars to undergraduate Pell recipients (UPGRNTT); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_federal_loan_count: All-undergraduate federal student-loan recipients (UFLOANN); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_federal_loan_avg: Average federal-loan dollars among undergraduate federal-loan recipients (UFLOANA); available from aid year 2008-09.
variables.ug_federal_loan_total: Total federal-loan dollars to undergraduate federal-loan recipients (UFLOANT); available from aid year 2008-09.

student_aid_net_price.description: Cost II net-price supplement for StudentAid in aid year 2023-24.

veterans_aid.description: Post-9/11 GI Bill and DoD Tuition Assistance benefits, by undergraduate and graduate level; SFAV aid years ending 2014-2024.

variables.year: Ending year of the benefit period (2014 means 2013-14).
variables.aid_year_start: Starting year of the benefit period (year minus one).
variables.ug_post911_total: Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars awarded to undergraduates (UGPO9_T).
variables.ug_post911_avg: Average Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars per undergraduate recipient (UGPO9_A).
variables.grad_post911_total: Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars awarded to graduate students (GPO9_T).
variables.grad_post911_avg: Average Post-9/11 GI Bill dollars per graduate recipient (GPO9_A).
variables.ug_dod_total: DoD Tuition Assistance dollars awarded to undergraduates (UGDOD_T).
variables.ug_dod_avg: Average DoD Tuition Assistance dollars per undergraduate recipient (UGDOD_A).
variables.grad_dod_total: DoD Tuition Assistance dollars awarded to graduate students (GDOD_T).
variables.grad_dod_avg: Average DoD Tuition Assistance dollars per graduate recipient (GDOD_A).

retention.description: First-year retention of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates, by full-time or part-time entering status; Fall Enrollment D files, 2003-2024. The reporting year is the fall when retention is measured, one year after entry.

variables.year: Fall reporting year in which retention is measured.
variables.cohort_year: Fall entering-cohort year; one year before the retention reporting year.
variables.ft_cohort: Full-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate cohort in the previous fall; available from 2007.
variables.ft_exclusions: Permitted exclusions from the prior-fall full-time cohort; available from 2007.
variables.ft_inclusions: Study-abroad students re-included in the full-time cohort; available from 2016.
variables.ft_adjusted_cohort: Prior-fall full-time cohort after exclusions and, from 2016, inclusions; available from 2007.
variables.ft_retained: Full-time entering-cohort students retained at the institution in the reporting fall (and qualifying early completers); available from 2007.
variables.ft_retention_rate: NCES-published first-year full-time entering-cohort retention rate, percent; available from 2003.
variables.pt_cohort: Part-time first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate cohort in the previous fall; available from 2007.
variables.pt_exclusions: Permitted exclusions from the prior-fall part-time cohort; available from 2007.
variables.pt_inclusions: Study-abroad students re-included in the part-time cohort; available from 2016.
variables.pt_adjusted_cohort: Prior-fall part-time cohort after exclusions and, from 2016, inclusions; available from 2007.
variables.pt_retained: Part-time entering-cohort students retained at the institution in the reporting fall (and qualifying early completers); available from 2007.
variables.pt_retention_rate: NCES-published first-year part-time entering-cohort retention rate, percent; available from 2003.
variables.ft_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_exclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_exclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_inclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_inclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_adjusted_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_adjusted_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_retained_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_retained; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.ft_retention_rate_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for ft_retention_rate; e.g., R reported, A not applicable, B blank, Z implied zero, or a correction/imputation code.
variables.pt_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_exclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_exclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_inclusions_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_inclusions; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_adjusted_cohort_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_adjusted_cohort; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_retained_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_retained; missing when the source field is unavailable.
variables.pt_retention_rate_status: NCES reporting/imputation status for pt_retention_rate; e.g., R reported, A not applicable, B blank, Z implied zero, or a correction/imputation code.

completion.description: Completion awards/degrees by field of study, award level, race/sex, and from 2001 first versus second major; available for 1984-2025. Before 2001, major order is not identified.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.year: Ending year of the July 1-June 30 award reporting period; e.g. C2025_A covers July 2024-June 2025. This is not a tracked graduation cohort.
variables.cip: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) code for a subject in a given year.
variables.totmen: Number of awards reported for men in this CIP and selected degree/major category; not a count of distinct people.
variables.totwomen: Number of awards reported for women in this CIP and selected degree/major category; not a count of distinct people.
variables.wtmen: Awards reported for non-Hispanic White men in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.wtwomen: Awards reported for non-Hispanic White women in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.bkmen: Awards reported for non-Hispanic Black men in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.bkwomen: Awards reported for non-Hispanic Black women in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.hspmen: Awards reported for Hispanic men in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.hspwomen: Awards reported for Hispanic women in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.asnmen: Awards reported for non-Hispanic Asian men in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.asnwomen: Awards reported for non-Hispanic Asian women in the selected CIP and award level.
variables.totwt_share: Non-Hispanic White share of reported awards within this CIP and selected level/major category.
variables.totbk_share: Non-Hispanic Black share of reported awards within this CIP and selected level/major category.
variables.tothsp_share: Hispanic share of reported awards within this CIP and selected level/major category.
variables.totasn_share: Non-Hispanic Asian share of reported awards within this CIP and selected level/major category.
variables.totmen_share: Men's share of reported awards within this CIP and selected level/major category.
variables.major_type: 'first' or 'second' when selected (2001+), 'both' when combined (2001+), or 'unspecified' for 1984-2000, when MAJORNUM was not recorded.
variables.deglevel: Degree level of completers; options include 'assc' (Associate's), 'bach' (Bachelor's), 'mast' (Master's), and 'doct' (Doctoral).

completers.description: Distinct students earning any award (C*_B) or a given award level with age categories (C*_C), for reporting periods ending 2012-2025. These are people, not counts of awards by CIP or first/second majors.

variables.year: Ending year of the July-June completion period (C2025_B is July 2024-June 2025).
variables.period_start_year: Starting year of the July-June completion reporting period.
variables.source_table: B for institution-wide unduplicated completers; C for distinct completers within each award level.
variables.award_level: 'all_awards' for B or named associate/bachelor/master/doctoral/certificate category for C.
variables.award_level_code: Normalized C AWLEVELC code without leading zeroes; missing for B.
variables.source_award_code: Original C AWLEVELC text, including any leading zeroes; missing for B.
variables.total_completers: Distinct students earning an award at the given grain (CSTOTLT); do not sum B and C or C levels to count unique people.
variables.men: Students in the reported men/male category (CSTOTLM).
variables.women: Students in the reported women/female category (CSTOTLW).
variables.pacific_islander: Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander completers (CSNHPIT).
variables.two_or_more: Completers identifying with two or more races (CS2MORT).
variables.age_under_18: Completers younger than 18 (CSUND18), present only in award-level C rows.
variables.age_18_to_24: Completers ages 18-24 (CS18_24), present only in award-level C rows.
variables.age_25_to_39: Completers ages 25-39 (CS25_39), present only in award-level C rows.
variables.age_40_plus: Completers ages 40 or older (CSABV40), present only in award-level C rows.
variables.age_unknown: Completers with age unknown (CSUNKN), present only in award-level C rows.
variables.age_under_18_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for age_under_18; missing in B.
variables.age_18_to_24_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for age_18_to_24; missing in B.
variables.age_25_to_39_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for age_25_to_39; missing in B.
variables.age_40_plus_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for age_40_plus; missing in B.
variables.age_unknown_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for age_unknown; missing in B.

completers_by_award.description: Completions C award-level source files for Completers(degree_level='award_levels').

graduation.description: Graduation data for each school in a given year, including information like the graduation rate by gender and race; available at the Associate or Bachelor's level; available for years 2000-2024.

variables.id: Institutional unique identifier ID; though UNITIDs can vary over time due to instutions splitting, this variable is generally consistent for an institution over time.
variables.year: Graduation reporting year; the bachelor's and associate's cohorts began approximately six and three years earlier, respectively.
variables.deglevel: Level of student degree; either 'bach' (Bachelor's) or 'assc' (Associates).
variables.totmen: Total number of men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.totmen_graduated: Total number of men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.totwomen: Total number of women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.totwomen_graduated: Total number of women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.wtmen: Total number of non-Hispanic White men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.wtmen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic White men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.wtwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic White women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.wtwomen_graduated: Total number of  non-Hispanic White women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.bkmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.bkmen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Black men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.bkwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.bkwomen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Black women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.hspmen: Total number of Hispanic men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.hspmen_graduated: Total number of Hispanic men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.hspwomen: Total number of Hispanic women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.hspwomen_graduated: Total number of Hispanic women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.asnmen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men within an adjusted cohort.
variables.asnmen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian men within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.asnwomen: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women within an adjusted cohort.
variables.asnwomen_graduated: Total number of non-Hispanic Asian women within an adjusted cohort that graduated within 150 percent of the normal time considered to graduate; for bachelor's degrees, this is six years, and for associate's degrees, this is three years.
variables.gradrate_totmen: Graduation rate for men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_totwomen: Graduation rate for women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_wtmen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic White men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_wtwomen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic White women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_bkmen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic Black men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_bkwomen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic Black women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_hspmen: Graduation rate for Hispanic men (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_hspwomen: Graduation rate for Hispanic women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_asnmen: Graduation rate for  non-Hispanic Asianmen (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).
variables.gradrate_asnwomen: Graduation rate for non-Hispanic Asian women (within 150 percent of normal time taken to graduate).

graduation200.description: GR200 outcomes at 100%, 150% and 200% of normal time for bachelor's or less-than-four-year degree/certificate cohorts; reporting years 2008-2024. The 2008 wave is supplemental.

variables.year: GR200 reporting/status year, not entering-cohort year.
variables.cohort_type: 'bachelor' or 'less_than_four_year'; less-than-four-year includes degree and certificate seekers, not only associate's students.
variables.cohort_year: Entering cohort year: year minus 8 for bachelor, year minus 4 for less-than-four-year.
variables.collection_phase: 'supplemental' for the first 2008 GR200 wave, otherwise 'standard'.
variables.revised_cohort: Revised original entering cohort (BAREVCT or L4REVCT).
variables.exclusions_150: Permitted exclusions by 150% of normal time (BAEXCLU or L4EXCLU).
variables.adjusted_cohort_150: Adjusted cohort for 100% and 150% measures (BAAC150 or L4AC150).
variables.completed_100: Number completing by 100% of normal time (BANC100 or L4NC100).
variables.rate_100: NCES-published completion percentage by 100% of normal time (BAGR100 or L4GR100); not recalculated by genpeds.
variables.completed_150: Number completing by 150% of normal time (BANC150 or L4NC150).
variables.rate_150: NCES-published completion percentage by 150% of normal time (BAGR150 or L4GR150); not the same entering cohort as Graduation(year).
variables.additional_exclusions_200: Additional exclusions after 150% before 200% (BAAEXCL or L4AEXCL).
variables.adjusted_cohort_200: Adjusted cohort for 200% of normal time after additional exclusions (BAAC200 or L4AC200).
variables.completed_150_to_200: New completions between 150% and 200% of normal time (BANC200A or L4NC200A); not the cumulative 200% count.
variables.still_enrolled: Students still enrolled at 200% status (BASTEND or L4STEND), available from 2011; missing before introduction.
variables.completed_200: Cumulative completions by 200% of normal time (BANC200 or L4NC200).
variables.rate_200: NCES-published 200% completion percentage (BAGR200 or L4GR200); 200% adjusted cohort may differ from the 150% denominator.
variables.completed_150_to_200_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for completed_150_to_200; source X flag omits one character from raw measure name.
variables.still_enrolled_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for still_enrolled; missing before 2011.

outcome_measures.description: Outcome Measures follows undergraduate degree/certificate-seeking entrants for awards by four/six/eight years and enrollment outcomes at eight years. Status years 2015-2024; 2017+ cohorts and definitions are expanded.

variables.year: OM eight-year reporting/status year; not entering-cohort year.
variables.entering_year_start: Beginning year of the entering July-June cohort, eight years before the OM status year.
variables.entering_year_end: End year of the entering July-June cohort, seven years before the OM status year.
variables.cohort_type: First-/non-first-time and full-/part-time entering cohort, plus overall total from 2017; overlapping total and subgroups must not be summed.
variables.pell_group: 'not_collected' before 2017; 2017+ 'total', 'pell', or 'non_pell'. Total overlaps Pell and non-Pell subcohorts.
variables.schema_version: 'initial' in 2015-16; 'expanded' from 2017. Denominator and award detail differ across versions.
variables.inconsistency_flag: Raw OMFLAG (2015 only): 0 no issues or 1 data inconsistencies; unavailable in later files.
variables.inconsistency_flag_label: Readable interpretation of 2015 OMFLAG; missing when not reported.
variables.revised_cohort_6: Revised entering cohort at six years (OMRCHT6), initial 2015-16 scheme only.
variables.exclusions_6: Permitted exclusions at six years (OMEXCL6), initial 2015-16 scheme only.
variables.adjusted_cohort_6: Adjusted entering cohort for six-year outcomes (OMACHT6), initial 2015-16 scheme only.
variables.revised_cohort_8: Revised entering cohort at eight years (OMRCHT8); present in initial 2015 file only.
variables.exclusions_8: Exclusions reported at eight years (OMEXCL8), 2015-16 only; 2016 dictionary calls these additional exclusions.
variables.adjusted_cohort_8: Adjusted entering cohort for eight-year outcomes (OMACHT8), initial 2015-16 scheme only.
variables.revised_cohort: Revised entering cohort for expanded 2017+ OM (OMRCHRT).
variables.exclusions: Permitted cohort exclusions for expanded 2017+ OM (OMEXCLS).
variables.adjusted_cohort: Adjusted entering cohort for expanded 2017+ outcomes (OMACHRT).
variables.awards_4: Adjusted-cohort students with any award from the institution by four years (OMAWDN4); available from 2017.
variables.awards_4_pct: NCES-published four-year award percentage (OMAWDP4); available from 2017.
variables.awards_6: Adjusted-cohort students with any award from the institution by six years (OMAWDN6).
variables.awards_6_pct: NCES-published six-year award percentage (OMAWDP6); denominators differ between initial and expanded schemas.
variables.awards_8: Adjusted-cohort students with any award from the institution by eight years (OMAWDN8).
variables.certificate_4: Students with a certificate as highest award at four years (OMCERT4), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.associate_4: Students with an associate degree as highest award at four years (OMASSC4), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.bachelor_4: Students with a bachelor's degree as highest award at four years (OMBACH4), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.certificate_6: Students with a certificate as highest award at six years (OMCERT6), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.associate_6: Students with an associate degree as highest award at six years (OMASSC6), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.bachelor_6: Students with a bachelor's degree as highest award at six years (OMBACH6), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.certificate_8: Students with a certificate as highest award at eight years (OMCERT8), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.associate_8: Students with an associate degree as highest award at eight years (OMASSC8), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.bachelor_8: Students with a bachelor's degree as highest award at eight years (OMBACH8), expanded 2017+ schema only.
variables.still_enrolled_here_8: Students still enrolled at the reporting institution at eight years (OMENRYI).
variables.subsequently_enrolled_elsewhere_8: Students known to have subsequently enrolled at another institution at eight years (OMENRAI).
variables.enrollment_unknown_8: Students whose subsequent enrollment status is unknown at eight years (OMENRUN).
variables.no_award_8: Students without an award from the reporting institution at eight years (OMNOAWD).
variables.enrolled_here_or_elsewhere_8_pct: NCES-published percentage still/subsequently enrolled at eight years (OMENRTP).
variables.still_enrolled_here_8_pct: NCES-published eight-year percentage still enrolled at this institution (OMENRYP).
variables.subsequently_enrolled_elsewhere_8_pct: NCES-published eight-year percentage subsequently enrolled elsewhere (OMENRAP).
variables.enrollment_unknown_8_pct: NCES-published eight-year percentage with unknown subsequent enrollment (OMENRUP), 2017+ only.
variables.revised_cohort_8_status: NCES reporting/imputation flag for revised_cohort_8 (2015 only).

cip.description: Provides subject field codes for subjects in a given year; should be used with Completion data; available for years 1984-2025.

variables.year: Year of the Completions data dictionary supplying this CIP description; CIP meanings can change with classification revisions. This is not a graduation cohort year.
variables.cip: CIP (Classification of Instructional Programs) identifier code.
